scope: Unreleased backend project management: neutral manifest, frozen read-only audit, current-service owned history and safe retention, three-language details, CLI frozen-backend tool selection.

fullApp.nativeArchiveAndMobileStoreHelpers: fresh local native tools supplied; zero optional tests skipped
fullApp.additionalTestScope: One new thrown-phase cleanup test was added after the full runner began; the complete final new domain was run separately.

focused.overlap: These counts overlap the full application and other focused logs; do not add them.

checks: clean saved manifest and exact file inventory

browser.scope: Real HTTP editor, actual Godot and Bevy tools, historical selection independent from current execution, close/reopen and scene-switch delayed response guards.
browser.visualInspection: Three narrow Godot details screenshots were inspected at their visible viewport only; Bevy details verified through exact DOM and actual manifest, its screenshot shows the upper build panel.

prepared.scope: Both copies run the pure manifest validator in standard VM globals; six desktop copied CLI checks. This is portability evidence, not a security sandbox or device acceptance. WASM bytes only, not a new WASM execution.

preservation.sharedRustAndWasm: unchanged; previous Rust119 evidence retained, no new Rust tests claimed
preservation.godotExecutionAdapter: Known import/UID sidecars are now cleaned; adapter fingerprint changed, old generated builds require a rebuild under existing admission.

retention.scope: Only outputs created by the current service instance
retention.quarantine: Rename to a random sibling then recheck exact inventory before ordinary cleanup; deterministic mutation fault tests pass. No transactional protection against arbitrary same-user continuous writes.

notes: Initial native host build lacked prepared desktop resources; preparation and subsequent build passed.
Initial actual Godot projects exposed import/UID sidecars; scoped adapter cleanup fixed that. Fourth initial case used an incorrect Bevy backend ID in the new smoke fixture; corrected in final smoke.
New pure/frozen fixture actor downgrade, pretty-JSON byte-budget fixture, legacy-path fixture, browser evaluate statement and retention spy expectations were corrected with original logs retained.
Initial standalone prepared proof assumed WebAssembly was absent from standard VM globals; corrected proof only asserts no Node/DOM/network.
First new atlas evidence kind used document; corrected to accepted design and regenerated.

cleanup.scope: Only initially absent generated copies and temporary native build targets created for this verification. No authors, installed applications, historical reports, shared WASM or external toolchains removed.
